topic: The woman who single-handedly stopped an entire invading army
hook: One woman faced an invading army — and they retreated.
script: One woman faced an invading army — and they retreated. In 1429, Joan of Arc was 17 when she led French forces against the English siege of Orléans. No military training. No noble rank. Just absolute certainty. She broke the siege in 9 days. Inspired a nation. Was later burned alive at 19. Her name echoes 600 years later. Follow for history's most fearless humans.
